{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_eng_start_delay", "thread_id": "th_eng_start", "from_": "vp-eng@company.example.com", "to": ["hr-ops@company.example.com", "intern-program@company.example.com"], "subject": "Engineering Intern Start Date Change", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2026-03-28T10:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_eng_start_delay

收件人：hr-ops@company.example.com, intern-program@company.example.com
日期：2026-03-28T10:00:00Z
主题：Engineering Intern Start Date Change
Hi team,

Due to our engineering team offsite June 2-6, our Engineering interns should start on June 9 instead of June 2. This only affects Engineering department interns. Other departments keep the original June 2 start date.

Please update the onboarding setup accordingly.

- VP Engineering"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_credit_card_policy", "thread_id": "th_cc_policy", "from_": "finance@company.example.com", "to": ["hr-ops@company.example.com"], "subject": "Corporate Credit Card Policy - Interns", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2026-03-25T09:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_credit_card_policy
来源：finance@company.example.com
收件人：hr-ops@company.example.com
日期：2026-03-25T09:00:00Z
主题：Corporate Credit Card Policy - Interns
Hi,

Per company policy, interns are NOT eligible for corporate credit cards. All intern expenses must be submitted through the expense reimbursement process via their mentor. Please do not request cards for interns.

- Finance"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_email_account_policy", "thread_id": "th_email_policy", "from_": "it-admin@company.example.com", "to": ["hr-ops@company.example.com"], "subject": "IT Policy: Intern Email Account Creation", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2026-03-26T11:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_email_account_policy
来源：it-admin@company.example.com
收件人：hr-ops@company.example.com
日期：2026-03-26T11:00:00Z
主题：IT Policy: Intern Email Account Creation
Team,

Intern email accounts require explicit manager approval before creation. HR must email the intern's assigned manager (or mentor) and get written confirmation before requesting the account. Send the account request to it-admin@company.example.com AFTER receiving manager approval.

Do NOT create accounts directly or request them without manager sign-off.

- IT Admin"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_conditional_bg_policy", "thread_id": "th_conditional_bg", "from_": "legal@company.example.com", "to": ["hr-ops@company.example.com"], "subject": "Background Check: Conditional Results Handling", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": true, "date": "2026-03-27T09:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_conditional_bg_policy
来源：legal@company.example.com
收件人：hr-ops@company.example.com
日期：2026-03-27T09:00:00Z
主题：Background Check: Conditional Results Handling
Team,

When a background check result is 'Conditional', the intern may proceed with onboarding BUT you must notify the legal team at legal@company.example.com with the intern's name and the conditional finding details. This is required before any onboarding activities begin.

Summary:
- Clear: proceed normally
- Conditional: proceed but notify legal first
- Pending: do not proceed
- Failed: do not proceed, notify legal

- Legal"}
